name: Computational Neuroscience
summary: Mathematical and computational models of neurons, circuits and learning, and how the brain encodes and decodes information.

topics.name: Single-neuron models: Hodgkin-Huxley, integrate-and-fire and reduced models
Compartmental and cable models of dendrites
Spike statistics: Poisson processes and variability
Neural encoding: tuning curves, receptive fields and GLMs
Neural decoding: population vectors and Bayesian decoding
Network models: rate models, attractors and balanced networks
Synaptic plasticity rules and Hebbian learning
Reinforcement learning models of behaviour and dopamine
Normative models: the Bayesian brain and efficient coding
Comparing brains with artificial neural networks
